records.subject: Welcome to Wrenfield, Willow Dynamics!
records.body:
Hi Ana,

Thanks for trying Wrenfield. A quick tip: projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them -- so the first few minutes are usually spent creating one project and adding a few tasks to it.

Let us know how it goes.

Best,
Nadia Goldberg

draft.subject: Re: adding seats — plus a hand with your first project
draft.body:
Hi Ana,

Thanks for the kind words on onboarding — great to hear. On your question: yes, seats can be added any time from Account Settings, and teammates can be bulk-invited from a CSV file instead of one at a time. Your ticket is still open, so the team will confirm there too.

Whenever you're ready, projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so one project with a few tasks is the quickest way to see Wrenfield in action.

Would a short call this week help? I'm happy to walk through that first project with you.

Best,
Nadia
